intakeSamples.Title: Faster service booking
intakeSamples.RawContent: Make it possible for a customer to book a service in under two minutes.

intakeSamples.Title: Booking & scheduling PRD
intakeSamples.RawContent: The platform shall allow customers to select a dealer, choose a service package, view available slots, and confirm a booking. It must support rescheduling and cancellation, send confirmations, and expose availability from workshop systems in near real-time.

intakeSamples.Title: Discovery workshop transcript
intakeSamples.RawContent: Dealers said double-booking is the #1 pain. Technicians want to see parts availability before accepting a job. Customers abandon booking when they cannot see price up front.

intakeSamples.Title: Q2 defect analysis
intakeSamples.RawContent: 37% of production incidents trace to payment timeouts and missing idempotency on retries. Recommend hardening the payment integration and event backbone.

intakeSamples.Title: GDPR & data residency
intakeSamples.RawContent: All customer PII must remain in EU regions. Customers must be able to request export and erasure of their data within 30 days. Audit logging is mandatory for all data access.

intakeSamples.Title: VSTP System Architecture Document
intakeSamples.RawContent: See SAD_Sections sheet for the full sectioned architecture (SAD-01 .. SAD-14) covering landing zone, identity, data platform, telematics, booking & workshop services, integrations, event backbone, web & mobile frontends, quality engineering, security & compliance, observability, and CI/CD.
